directions.label: Afrobeats / Afropop
directions.traits: Interlocking syncopated percussion, buoyant bass, melodic sung call and response and clear evolving hooks.
directions.audio: A Afrobeats / Afropop song with interlocking percussion, melodic bass, bright guitar or keys and singing.

directions.label: Amapiano
directions.traits: Amapiano with log-drum bass, spacious shuffling percussion, warm piano and melodic sung hooks.
directions.audio: A Amapiano song with log drum bass, shuffling percussion, warm piano and singing.

directions.label: Reggaeton / Latin urban
directions.traits: Dembow rhythm, deep bass, rhythmic vocal phrasing and a melodic chorus with changing sections.
directions.audio: A Reggaeton / Latin urban song with dembow drums, deep bass, rhythmic synth or guitar and singing.

directions.label: Flamenco
directions.traits: Expressive flamenco-inspired singing, articulate nylon guitar, handclap rhythmic interplay and dynamic verses.
directions.audio: A Flamenco song with nylon guitar, handclaps, acoustic bass and singing.

directions.label: Arabic traditions / pop
directions.traits: Respect the supplied regional tradition: expressive ornamental melody, interlocking hand percussion and clear sung phrasing. Do not equate language with genre.
directions.audio: A Arabic traditions / pop song with oud or regional strings, hand percussion, melodic bass and singing.

directions.label: South Asian traditions / film
directions.traits: Use the supplied South Asian style as musical guidance, expressive melodic ornament, appropriate regional percussion and a memorable sung refrain.
directions.audio: A South Asian traditions / film song with regional melodic strings or keys, tabla or regional percussion, bass and singing.

directions.label: Lo-fi
directions.traits: Lo-fi warmth, loose pocket, warm harmonic color and understated melodic singing, with developing verses rather than a static loop.
directions.audio: A Lo-fi song with warm electric piano, rounded bass, loose dusty drums and singing.

directions.label: Experimental / art music
directions.traits: Coherent experimental songwriting with surprising textures, purposeful space, evolving motifs and a recognizable original sung refrain.
directions.audio: A Experimental / art music song with textural synth or guitar, expressive bass, changing percussion and singing.

directions.label: Heavy rock / metal
directions.traits: Riff-led heavy rock and metal, driving rhythmic momentum, powerful projected melodic vocals, punchy kick and snare, dynamic full-band choruses. Keep the music heavy even in quieter passages.
directions.audio: A heavy metal or hard rock song with distorted electric guitar riffs, bass, loud drums and powerful singing.

directions.label: Alternative / rock
directions.traits: A guitar-led alternative rock band, distinct rhythmic riffs, expressive projected singing, energetic drums and dynamic choruses.
directions.audio: An alternative rock song with electric guitars, bass, live rock drums and expressive singing.

directions.label: Jazz
directions.traits: Harmonically rich vocal jazz, syncopated or swinging phrasing, acoustic ensemble interplay and expressive natural vocals.
directions.audio: A jazz song with piano, upright bass, jazz drums and a jazz singer.

directions.label: R&B / soul
directions.traits: Expressive R&B and soul singing, rich chords, rhythmic pocket, warm ensemble textures and a memorable melodic chorus.
directions.audio: An R&B or soul song with soulful singing, electric piano, bass and a smooth drum groove.

directions.label: Blues
directions.traits: Blues groove, expressive bent guitar notes, blues harmony, soulful projected vocals and instrumental call and response.
directions.audio: A blues song with expressive blues guitar, bass, drums and soulful blues singing.

directions.label: Country / folk
directions.traits: Organic country or folk songwriting, storytelling vocals, acoustic string textures and a grounded rhythmic pulse.
directions.audio: A country or folk song with acoustic guitar, bass, organic percussion and storytelling singing.

directions.label: Reggae
directions.traits: Laid-back but rhythmic reggae, offbeat guitar skanks, strong bass movement, relaxed natural singing and syncopated percussion.
directions.audio: A reggae song with offbeat guitar skanks, deep bass, reggae drums and singing.

directions.label: Hip-hop / rap
directions.traits: Hip-hop pocket, rhythmically varied rap verses and a melodic sung chorus, deliberate flow, punchy drums and space around the vocal.
directions.audio: A hip hop or rap song with rhythmic rapping, a sung hook, punchy beats and deep bass.

directions.label: Dance / EDM
directions.traits: Rhythmic electronic dance music with builds, release, a clear club groove, sung hooks and an evolving bass-driven arrangement.
directions.audio: An electronic dance or house song with a driving dance beat, synthesizers, bass and vocal hooks.

directions.label: Chill / lo-fi
directions.traits: Spacious mellow music, understated rhythmic details, warm textures, intimate natural singing and subtle development.
directions.audio: A mellow chill or lo-fi song with soft keys, warm bass, restrained drums and gentle singing.

directions.label: Electronic / synth-pop
directions.traits: Synth-led electronic pop, rhythmic arpeggios, distinct synth-bass motion, expressive sung hooks and evolving electronic textures.
directions.audio: An electronic synth pop or synthwave song with synthesizers, synth bass, electronic drums and singing.

directions.label: Classical / orchestral
directions.traits: Classically influenced vocal composition, developed melodic motifs, acoustic orchestration, nuanced dynamics and sustained expressive singing.
directions.audio: A classical vocal or orchestral song with acoustic piano, strings and classical singing.

directions.label: Funk / disco
directions.traits: Danceable funk or disco pocket, syncopated bass and guitar, crisp drums, joyful rhythmic vocals and an infectious chorus.
directions.audio: A funk or disco song with syncopated electric bass, rhythm guitar, tight drums and singing.

directions.label: Latin
directions.traits: Latin rhythmic phrasing, interlocking percussion, melodic bass and expressive sung hooks, with clear instrumental answers.
directions.audio: A Latin song with syncopated percussion, rhythmic bass, guitar or piano and singing.

directions.label: Indie
directions.traits: Distinctive indie songwriting, intimate but melodic vocals, textured guitars and changing band dynamics with a memorable refrain.
directions.audio: An indie pop or indie rock song with textured guitars, melodic bass, drums and singing.

directions.label: Pop
directions.traits: Melodic pop with a clear rhythmic pulse, developing verses, a strong singable chorus and expressive natural vocals.
directions.audio: A pop song with catchy singing, rhythmic drums, bass and melodic accompaniment.

directions.label: Folk / regional traditions
directions.traits: Preserve the specific regional folk tradition in the supplied catalogue labels, acoustic instrumental interplay and expressive original sung storytelling. Do not mash unrelated traditions together.
directions.audio: A Folk / regional traditions song with regional acoustic strings, acoustic bass, hand percussion and singing.
